result.instructions: Tools for ReturnLogic, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which returns are waiting for my action right now?"; "Show me all refund returns requested this week and their reasons."; "Look up the return for order #1042 and tell me what has been received.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ReturnLogic data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run returnlogic_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run returnlogic_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run returnlogic_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. returnlogic_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_rmas
tools.title: List returns (RMAs)
tools.description: List return merchandise authorizations (RMAs, i.e. customer returns) with workflow status, return type (refund, exchange, warranty, giftcard), items, customer email and order. Filter by status, type, reason, email, order, date range, flags or 'requires action'. GET /v1/rmas.

created_after.description: Only RMAs created on or after this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only RMAs created on or before this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

workflow_status.description: Only RMAs in one of these workflow statuses.

return_type.description: Only RMAs with one of these return types.

return_reason_code.description: Only RMAs with one of these return reason codes.

email.description: RMAs whose RMA email or order email matches one of these (case-insensitive, exact).

show_archived.description: true = only archived RMAs, false = only non-archived.

third_party_only.description: Only RMAs whose order is not from Shopify.

requires_action.description: Only RMAs that are not scheduled for automatic processing and need a person.

only_warranty_out_of_stock.description: Only RMAs flagged Contact Customer Support (warranty item out of stock).

only_unpaid_invoices.description: Only exchange or warranty RMAs with unpaid invoices.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: returnlogic_count_rmas
tools.title: Count returns (RMAs)
tools.description: Count RMAs matching the same filters as returnlogic_list_rmas (for example how many returns are Requested or require action). GET /v1/rmas/count.

created_after.description: Only RMAs created on or after this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only RMAs created on or before this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

workflow_status.description: Only RMAs in one of these workflow statuses.

return_type.description: Only RMAs with one of these return types.

return_reason_code.description: Only RMAs with one of these return reason codes.

email.description: RMAs whose RMA email or order email matches one of these (case-insensitive, exact).

show_archived.description: true = only archived RMAs, false = only non-archived.

third_party_only.description: Only RMAs whose order is not from Shopify.

requires_action.description: Only RMAs that are not scheduled for automatic processing and need a person.

only_warranty_out_of_stock.description: Only RMAs flagged Contact Customer Support (warranty item out of stock).

only_unpaid_invoices.description: Only exchange or warranty RMAs with unpaid invoices.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma
tools.title: Get return (RMA)
tools.description: One RMA by id: status, comments, order link, shopper and warehouse addresses, items with quantities, reasons, approval/receipt state, labels and timeline. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma_item_type_history
tools.title: Get return type history of an RMA item
tools.description: The history of return-type changes (e.g. refund changed to exchange) of one RMA item. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaItemId}/returntypehistory.

rma_item_id.description: ReturnLogic RMA item id (rlRmaItemId, from an RMA's items).

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma_metafields
tools.title: Get RMA metafields
tools.description: Custom metafields (key, value, reportable) stored on an RMA. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/metafields.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_rma_item_metafields
tools.title: Get RMA item metafields
tools.description: Custom metafields stored on one item of an RMA. GET /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/items/{rlRmaItemId}/metafields.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders known to ReturnLogic (synced from the store) with items, customer, amounts and statuses. Filter by order number/name, email, date range or financial status. GET /v1/orders.

order_name.description: Find orders by order name, e.g. #1001.

email.description: Find orders by customer email (case-insensitive, exact).

created_after.description: Only orders created on or after this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only orders created on or before this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

financial_status.description: Only orders with this financial status.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: returnlogic_count_orders
tools.title: Count orders
tools.description: Count orders matching the same filters as returnlogic_list_orders. GET /v1/orders/count.

order_name.description: Find orders by order name, e.g. #1001.

email.description: Find orders by customer email (case-insensitive, exact).

created_after.description: Only orders created on or after this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only orders created on or before this moment. A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

financial_status.description: Only orders with this financial status.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by ReturnLogic order id (rlOrderId) with its line items, addresses and statuses. GET /v1/orders/{rlOrderId}.

order_id.description: ReturnLogic order id (rlOrderId; the rlOrderId field of an RMA).

tools.name: returnlogic_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, or find one by email or external customer id. GET /v1/customers/list.

external_customer_id.description: The customer's id in the store (e.g. the Shopify customer id).

skip.description: Number of items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: returnlogic_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by ReturnLogic customer id (rlCustomerId). GET /v1/customers/{rlCustomerId}.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with their variants (SKUs, barcodes). Filter by SKU, category id, status or external (store) product ids. GET /v1/products.

sku.description: Only products with a variant matching this SKU.

category_id.description: Only products in this ReturnLogic category id.

status.description: active, inActive or any (default per API).

external_product_ids.description: Only products matching these store product ids.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: returnlogic_count_products
tools.title: Count products
tools.description: Count products matching a SKU, category or status filter. GET /v1/products/count.

sku.description: Only products with a variant matching this SKU.

category_id.description: Only products in this ReturnLogic category id.

status.description: active, inActive or any (default per API).

tools.name: returnlogic_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by ReturnLogic product id (rlProductId) with its variants. GET /v1/products/{rlProductId}.

tools.name: returnlogic_list_product_categories
tools.title: List product categories
tools.description: List product categories (used for return rules). Search by name or external category ids. GET /v1/productCategories.

external_category_ids.description: Only categories matching these store category ids.

skip.description: Number of items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

tools.name: returnlogic_flag_rma
tools.title: Flag an RMA
tools.description: WRITE: flag an RMA so the team can filter for it, with an optional comment. A flag cannot be removed afterwards. It sends nothing to the customer. POST /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/flag.

comment.description: Why the RMA is flagged (visible to the team).

tools.name: returnlogic_mark_rma_items_received
tools.title: Mark RMA items received
tools.description: WRITE: record the warehouse receipt of one or more RMA items (received true/false, optional disposition code that must already exist in ReturnLogic). When every item is received the RMA becomes Received, and if the store uses Automated Processing for Received, the RMA may then be processed automatically (refund, exchange or gift card issued, and the customer notified by ReturnLogic). Use only on the operator's instruction. PUT /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/fulfillment.

received.description: true = the item arrived at the warehouse, false = not (yet) received.

disposition_code.description: An existing disposition code to record for the item.

tools.name: returnlogic_add_rma_metafields
tools.title: Add RMA metafields
tools.description: WRITE: add custom metafields (key/value notes or reference numbers) to an RMA. A key can be used once per RMA. 'reportable' true makes the field visible on RMAs and reports; false keeps it API-only. Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /v1/rmas/{rlRmaId}/metafields.

reportable.description: true = visible on RMAs and reports; false = only available through the API.
